user.title: Smarthome UI Core
user.description: Notifications and household data for the Smarthome UI dashboard. Everything is set up in the dashboard.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Smarthome UI Core is already set up.

user.title: Add robot mower
user.description: Pick the mower's device. Smarthome UI Core finds state, areas, self check and blades itself and remembers when each area was mowed – even without an open dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Change robot mower
reconfigure.description: Mow/vacuum automatically: when the robot may start on its own if areas or rooms are due (switch "... automatically" on the device). Every condition can be switched off.

abort.already_configured: This robot mower is already added.

user.title: Add robot vacuum
user.description: Pick the vacuum's device. Smarthome UI Core remembers when it cleaned each room (with a room sensor, e.g. Roborock) and notifies about errors, the station and wear parts – even without an open dashboard.

reconfigure.title: Change robot vacuum
